fixture_metadata.scope_notice: Synthetic demonstration dataset representing a fictional electric vehicle manufacturer (AUGI) and its concept SUV program (AUGI Sable). All employees, workflows, chassis dimensions, material properties, and stiffness/deflection readouts are invented concept approximations for interactive 3D browser visualization. No real automaker data, real employees, physical test results, finite-element solver outputs, crashworthiness ratings, or regulatory certifications are represented.

capture_policy.cad_ip_boundary: Full native CATIA/NX solid assemblies remain on engineering workstations; MCP reports attach only parametric envelope tables, section properties, and material card IDs.

approved_app_catalog.name: Sable Subsystem Mass & Center-of-Gravity Ledger
capabilities: Tracks tabular part mass budgets, front/rear axle weight split, and vertical Z-height center-of-gravity across AUGI Sable subsystems.
non_capabilities: Provides static spreadsheet tables only; has no 3D chassis geometry, parametric dimension/gauge controls, or torsional/bending deflection calculations.

approved_app_catalog.name: BIW Mixed-Material Joining & Adhesive Registry
capabilities: Validates self-piercing rivet (SPR) die combinations, flow-drill screw (FDS) stackups, and structural epoxy bond-line thickness rules for aluminum-to-boron-steel flanges.
non_capabilities: Does not evaluate full-chassis global torsional or vertical bending stiffness.

approved_app_catalog.name: 800V Pack Envelope & Skid-Plate Clearance Checker
capabilities: Verifies 2D cross-section tolerances between 800V cell modules, cold plates, and lower ballistic shield panels.
non_capabilities: Does not model 3D chassis subframes, wheelbase variations, or global load-case deformations.

recurring_workflows.title: AUGI Sable 3D Concept Chassis Architecture & Load-Case Tradeoff Review
recurring_workflows.problem_summary: Ahead of Gate C2 architecture freeze, BIW, battery, casting, and vehicle dynamics engineers repeatedly write ad-hoc Python scripts in chat sessions to estimate how switching between a modular extruded frame (Config A), a structural cell-to-body boron-hybrid frame (Config B), and a front/rear megacast skateboard (Config C)—along with sweeping wheelbase (2920-3160 mm), track width, and rocker wall gauge (2.2-4.5 mm)—changes structural mass, torsional stiffness (kN·m/deg), and vertical bending sag.

catalog_evaluation.gap_explanation: app_augi_bom_mass_ledger records static mass rows and cannot render interactive 3D skateboard geometry, compare configurations side-by-side, or compute parametric beam/shell stiffness and deformation profiles.

recurring_workflows.recommended_action: Commission sandbox build of AUGI Sable 3D Chassis Comparator (apps/augi-engineering) using packages/organization-ui and React Three Fiber.

recurring_workflows.title: Aluminum-to-22MnB5 Boron Pillar Flange SPR & Epoxy Stackup Lookup
recurring_workflows.problem_summary: Engineers pasted flange thickness pairs into chat to check SPR rivet length and galvanic adhesive bead width rules.
recurring_workflows.recommended_action: Route directly to app_augi_fastener_weld_matrix; no new approval gate.

proposed_chassis_comparison_app.name: AUGI Sable 3D Chassis Architecture Comparator
proposed_chassis_comparison_app.rendering_technology: Three.js + React Three Fiber (@react-three/fiber) interactive WebGL canvas

camera_and_viewport_controls.orbit: Left-drag or arrow keys to orbit azimuth and elevation around chassis center
camera_and_viewport_controls.pan: Right-drag or Shift+arrow keys to pan across front cradle, battery bay, and rear casting
camera_and_viewport_controls.zoom: Scroll wheel or +/- keys with clamped near/far clipping planes
camera_and_viewport_controls.tilt_and_presets: Quick orthographic/perspective presets: Isometric, Top Plan, Side Elevation, Front Axle Section, Underbody Load Path
camera_and_viewport_controls.reset_view: Single-click camera and deformation reset to nominal unloaded state
camera_and_viewport_controls.reduced_motion_mode: Disables continuous oscillation and camera fly-to easing while preserving static deformed mesh inspection and exact tabular comparison

illustrative_load_cases.name: Static Axle-Twist Torsion
illustrative_load_cases.applied_load_label: 18,000 N·m front-axle opposing vertical wheel couple (±10.65 kN at 1690 mm track)
illustrative_load_cases.boundary_conditions: Rear shock tower mounts pinned in X/Y/Z; front suspension strut towers loaded with anti-symmetric vertical couple ±M_t.
illustrative_load_cases.primary_output_metric: Global Torsional Stiffness K_t (kN·m/deg) and Peak Twist Angle (deg)
illustrative_load_cases.deformation_visualization: Helical twist gradient along wheelbase with normalized shear-strain color map across rocker extrusions and battery floor shear web (visual amplification 45x).

illustrative_load_cases.name: Symmetric 3-Point Vertical Bending
illustrative_load_cases.applied_load_label: 32,000 N distributed battery pack + occupant vertical load (approx. 2.0 g static bump factor)
illustrative_load_cases.boundary_conditions: Front and rear axle centerlines simply supported vertically; uniform line load distributed along the battery enclosure rails.
illustrative_load_cases.primary_output_metric: Global Vertical Bending Stiffness K_b (kN/mm) and Mid-Span Vertical Sag delta_z (mm)
illustrative_load_cases.deformation_visualization: Parabolic vertical sag curve between axles highlighting rocker bottom-flange tension and crossmember compression (visual amplification 60x).

illustrative_load_cases.name: Quasi-Static Cornering Subframe Shear
illustrative_load_cases.applied_load_label: 24,000 N lateral cornering force split 52% front / 48% rear at lower control-arm mounts
illustrative_load_cases.boundary_conditions: Central battery tunnel constrained laterally; lateral forces applied at front and rear cradle hardpoints.
illustrative_load_cases.primary_output_metric: Subframe Lateral Compliance (mm/10kN) and Cradle-to-Sill Joint Peak Stress Index
illustrative_load_cases.deformation_visualization: Lateral yaw-shear displacement of front and rear subframes relative to the central battery box (visual amplification 50x).

baseline_chassis_configurations.name: Modular Multi-Extrusion & Stamped Subframe
baseline_chassis_configurations.architecture_summary: Conventional EV skateboard with 4-cell 6082-T6 aluminum sill extrusions, stamped 5754 aluminum floor pans, bolted multi-piece welded front/rear subframes, and a bolt-in battery pack isolated on elastomer mounts (non-structural pack).

materials_and_joining.front_rear_cradles: Stamped & MIG-welded AA 6061-T6 sheet/tube assembly (34 parts front, 38 parts rear)
materials_and_joining.crossmembers: 4 roll-formed AA 6082-T6 seat and floor crossmembers
materials_and_joining.battery_integration: Non-structural bolt-in tray (28 M10 mounting bolts); pack contributes 15% shear coupling

strengths: Lowest prototype tooling investment; uses standard extrusion dies and stamped weldments.
Straightforward serviceability for rear collision repair and bolt-out battery pack removal.
weaknesses: Highest structural mass (384 kg) and part count (142 parts) due to overlapping mounting flanges.
Lowest torsional stiffness (34.2 kN·m/deg) because the battery top cover does not act as a continuous shear web.

baseline_chassis_configurations.name: Cell-to-Body (CTB) Extruded Rocker + 22MnB5 Boron Torque Rings
baseline_chassis_configurations.architecture_summary: Structural Cell-to-Body integration where the 800V pack top lid doubles as the cabin floor shear panel, flanked by deep-section 6082-T6 aluminum rockers and reinforced at the A-post/dash and B-pillar cross-car bulkheads with hot-stamped 22MnB5 boron steel torque rings.

materials_and_joining.front_rear_cradles: Cast-node + extruded-rail hybrid subframes with 22MnB5 boron steel dash/bulkhead rings
materials_and_joining.crossmembers: 2 integrated high-strength boron steel cross-car beams + internal battery cell-to-body shear ribs
materials_and_joining.battery_integration: Structural CTB continuous structural adhesive + flow-drill screw perimeter flange (82% shear coupling)

strengths: Reduces lower chassis mass by 28 kg vs SABLE-A while raising torsional stiffness by 30.4% (44.6 kN·m/deg).
Lowers cabin floor Z-height by 14 mm by eliminating the separate body floor stamping above the battery lid.
weaknesses: Requires strict galvanic corrosion isolation and controlled SPR/adhesive curing between 6082 aluminum and 22MnB5 boron steel.
Full pack lowering requires detaching the structural perimeter seal.

baseline_chassis_configurations.name: Front & Rear HPDC Megacastings + Structural CTB Pack
baseline_chassis_configurations.architecture_summary: Single-piece high-pressure vacuum die-cast AlSi7Mg (C611-type) front and rear underbody megacastings with integral rib-on-shell shock towers and longitudinal rails, bridged by a structural CTB 800V battery enclosure and extruded 6082-T6 side sills.

materials_and_joining.sill_alloy: AA 6082-T6 extruded side sills with sacrificial bolt-on outer crush cans
materials_and_joining.front_rear_cradles: 2 monolithic HPDC AlSi7Mg non-heat-treated megacastings (variable rib thickness 2.6 mm - 4.8 mm; 3.4 mm equivalent shell)
materials_and_joining.crossmembers: Cast-in rear shock-tower bridge + structural CTB transverse cell-bay bulkheads
materials_and_joining.battery_integration: Structural CTB pack bolted and bonded directly into cast front/rear bulkheads and side sills (90% shear coupling)

strengths: Lowest structural mass (338 kg, -46 kg vs SABLE-A) and consolidates 142 lower-body stampings/extrusions into 31 components.
Highest concept torsional stiffness (49.8 kN·m/deg) and lowest lateral suspension cradle compliance due to integral cast shock towers.
weaknesses: Highest die-casting capital expenditure (requires 9,000-ton class HPDC presses) and longest die-tuning lead time.
Moderate/severe rear rail impacts beyond the bolt-on crush cans require specialized cast-section replacement procedures.

documented_synthetic_assumptions.purpose: Defines the exact analytical equations and bounds used by the browser 3D comparator so engineers can inspect how parameter sliders affect mass, stiffness, and visual deflection.
documented_synthetic_assumptions.inline_ui_disclosure_text: Concept beam-and-shell approximation (units: mm, kg, kN·m/deg). Analytical scaling for architecture comparison only—not a finite-element solver, physical rig test, or crashworthiness certification.

analytical_scaling_laws.mass_model: M_total = M_cradles(track, gauge, rho) + M_sills(wheelbase, gauge, rho) + M_floor_and_crossmembers(wheelbase, track, gauge, rho), scaled linearly with component envelope lengths, wall gauge (t / t_nom), and material density (rho / rho_nom).
analytical_scaling_laws.torsional_stiffness_model: Closed-box Bredt-Batho & subframe series-spring approximation: K_t = K_t0 * (G / G_nom) * (t / t_nom)^1.15 * (W_track / W_nom)^1.4 * (L_nom / L_wheelbase)^0.85 * C_pack_coupling.
analytical_scaling_laws.vertical_bending_stiffness_model: Euler-Bernoulli composite rail approximation: K_b = K_b0 * (E / E_nom) * (t / t_nom)^1.10 * (H_sill / H_nom)^1.8 * (L_nom / L_wheelbase)^2.4.
analytical_scaling_laws.visual_deformation_amplification: True elastic deflections under static test loads (0.36 deg twist; 1.5-2.2 mm vertical sag) are sub-pixel at whole-vehicle scale. The 3D viewport applies a user-visible display scale factor (45x for torsion, 60x for bending, 50x for lateral shear) while the inspector readout always reports unscaled physical engineering units.

explicit_non_claims: Does not solve nonlinear elasto-plastic material yield, local buckling, spot-weld nugget fracture, or crash energy absorption.
Does not substitute for LS-DYNA, Abaqus, or Nastran full-vehicle finite-element meshes or physical BIW K&C rig testing.
